metadata.description: Building on prior work that identified the structural myopia of autoregressive generation, this paper synthesizes these observations through a chess‑engine analogy and introduces the Society of Specialised LLMs—a multi‑agent architecture with five roles that provides formal guarantees of search amplification and state sufficiency for fully specified constraint‑satisfaction tasks. This is a preprint under review at a journal.
